evaluation: Require a positive lower 95% paired player-cluster bootstrap bound for correct known acceptance versus cosine alone and no increase in observed unknown acceptance. Report closed top-1, open correct known acceptance, unknown acceptance, a fixed 0.25 sensitivity, and the raw binding margin against the strongest incorrect cosine rival when the correct candidate reaches the shortlist. Count each of the two queries per player together in 10000 bootstrap draws. Raw tie-break diagnostic conditional on shortlist, exploratory.
followup: Independent players, separate 72-enrolled / 36-unknown pools in folds 1 and 2. Select by a new fixed hash among original rank-ambiguous questions, exclude all original participants. No new fitting. Main replication outcome: the player-averaged intact-minus-displaced margin against the highest cosine rival on games in which the genuine player is initially #2 or #3. Stratify owner bootstrap by pool. Report deployed identity outcomes with the original fold-1 thresholds.
motivation: Follow up the positive within-rank fingerprint and unsuccessful rank-transfer study. Does intact-minus-displaced action evidence help a strong frozen R1 identifier choose among its three nearest candidates, including when the query is from an unregistered player?
population: Reuse the 108 distinct players per fold of selection.json. For this separate identity task, order people by SHA256('verify-enrollment-v1|'+owner). Enroll the first 72 and reserve the last 36 as unknown. Order each person's five games by SHA256('verify-roles-v1|'+game key). Use the first three as references only for enrolled people and the last two as single-game queries for everybody.
rejection: Accept when the gap from the top rescored candidate to the runner-up strictly exceeds a threshold. For each multiplier set this to the fourth largest of 72 unknown-game gaps on fold 1 (at most three accepted). Select the multiplier maximizing correctly ranked and accepted known queries on fold 1. Freeze weights and thresholds before evaluation on fold 2.
reranking: Intact minus within-person action-displaced observed-move log-likelihood from both frozen conditional-model seeds (average seeds and moves). Standardize this difference across all 72 candidates per query and add it to the baseline top three with a nonnegative multiplier. Pick from 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1 on fold 1 only, using the smallest in case of ties.
retrieval: Cross-fit M218 g25 seed 30 excluding the query fold, using its best frozen checkpoint. Unit-length mean of three own-side embeddings per candidate, cosine scores for every query. Standardize each query's scores over the 72 candidates. Freeze the top three by cosine.
scope: Small equal-reference enrollment pool, no target rank at inference, fold 0 and official data excluded. Measures complementary identity evidence, not the competition's full opponent pool or a rank-score gain.
